items.title: Digital Transformation Program Weekly Steering Committee
items.attendees: Anjali Kalavar · Will Brown · Davis Dean · Melissa Hart · Carlos Vega · Jennifer Lee · Raj Patel · Amy Chen
items.detail: Roadmap, Wave 1 readiness, security and identity issues, governance and adoption readiness.

provenance.author: Anjali Kalavar
provenance.quote: Today's goal is to review the digital transformation roadmap, discuss readiness for Wave 1 migrations, and address security concerns that emerged during architecture reviews.

items.title: Propose an escalation process for applications with no identified business owner
items.detail: Carlos Vega raised it and left the owner as TBD in the meeting.

provenance.author: Anjali Kalavar
provenance.quote: Let us capture an action to propose an escalation process for applications without identified business owners.

items.title: Provide updated network segmentation testing status and dependency findings
items.detail: Testing slipped on firewall rule dependencies missed in discovery.

provenance.author: Anjali Kalavar
provenance.quote: Jennifer, please provide an updated network segmentation testing status and dependency findings by August 21.

items.title: Identify legacy systems that need authentication exception handling
items.detail: Melissa Hart asked for the recommendation before the next steering committee, which the transcript never dates.

provenance.author: Anjali Kalavar
provenance.quote: I can work with the application teams to identify systems that require exception handling.

items.title: Report on change champion identification across business units
items.detail: Carlos Vega said he had no owner or date for it.

provenance.author: Anjali Kalavar
provenance.quote: Someone from the change management workstream should provide an update on change champion identification, but I do not have a specific owner or date yet.

items.title: Complete the vendor security assessment review and summarise findings
items.detail: Outstanding responses concern data retention controls. End of the month read as 2026-08-31.

provenance.author: Anjali Kalavar
provenance.quote: I can complete the outstanding vendor security assessment response review and summarize the findings by the end of the month.

items.title: Establish a formal Architecture Review Board
items.detail: Recommended by Anjali Kalavar because decisions were being made informally; no objections noted.

provenance.author: Anjali Kalavar
provenance.quote: Alright, let's proceed with establishing the Architecture Review Board.

items.title: Hold the Wave 1 deferral candidates as tentative pending dependency analysis
items.detail: Candidates named were the analytics reporting suite and two departmental workflows. Wave 1 scope itself was not confirmed either way.

provenance.author: Anjali Kalavar
provenance.quote: Let's make that tentative for now until we see updated dependency analysis.

items.title: Network segmentation testing is roughly two weeks behind schedule
items.detail: Firewall rule dependencies not captured during discovery. No severity spoken.

provenance.author: Anjali Kalavar
provenance.quote: Regarding Wave 1, the cloud landing zone build is progressing, but network segmentation testing is behind schedule.

items.title: Cloud consumption is trending above the first-quarter infrastructure budget
items.detail: Overrun size unknown; finance is validating the numbers. No severity spoken.

provenance.author: Anjali Kalavar
provenance.quote: Current estimates are trending above expectations.

items.title: Orphaned applications have users but nobody owning maintenance or modernisation
items.detail: About 15% of in-scope systems are still uninventoried, mostly departmental tools. No severity spoken.

provenance.author: Anjali Kalavar
provenance.quote: Some of those applications are effectively orphaned.

items.title: Legacy systems cannot meet the planned authentication standards
items.detail: May require temporary security exceptions; analysis outstanding. No severity spoken.

provenance.author: Anjali Kalavar
provenance.quote: Some legacy systems can't support the authentication standards we originally planned.

items.title: Post-go-live operating model unfinalised, including who approves security exceptions
items.detail: Stakeholder interviews surfaced the same uncertainty on post-migration support ownership. No severity spoken.

provenance.author: Anjali Kalavar
provenance.quote: We still haven't finalized the operating model, and people are asking who will approve security exceptions after go-live.

items.title: Adoption readiness is behind: training incomplete and change champions unnamed
items.detail: Raised by Will Brown under adoption readiness. No severity spoken.

provenance.author: Anjali Kalavar
provenance.quote: Training materials are only partially complete, and several business units haven't identified change champions.
